summary: Implemented canonical artifact promotion for phase reports. Added a reusable promotion state machine with Draft, Validated, Certified, Canonical, Rejected, and Quarantined states. Only Certified artifacts can become Canonical. Phase report writes now route latest.md/latest.json through promote_artifact(...), while quarantine writes route through quarantine_artifact(...). Rejected and quarantined artifacts never promote and never overwrite latest.*. Successful lifecycle behavior remains compatible. No notification enforcement, push-check integration, Runtime Snapshot, Runtime Inspect, Permission Broker, authorization, execution runtime, plugins, Telegram inbound, REST, Web UI, or Dashboard changes were made. Execution capability remains unavailable.
